about.title: Welcome
about.subtitle: A rural house where La Mancha tradition meets modern comfort. Located in Arenales de San Gregorio, the perfect setting to disconnect.
about.inTheHeart: In the heart of La Mancha
about.architectureP1: Casa Eufemia combines traditional La Mancha architecture with modern amenities. Its adobe walls maintain a pleasant temperature throughout the year.
about.architectureP2: The house is distributed on a single floor of 290m², with large bright spaces including a living-dining room with fireplace, equipped kitchen, three double bedrooms and a full bathroom.
about.architectureP3: The exterior includes an extensive garden with swimming pool, shaded rest areas and multiple corners to enjoy the Mediterranean climate.
